$description: Template for docs/development-workflow/experience/05b-design-tokens.json. Canonical for token values, aliases, groups, themes, and modes. Replace every placeholder with a confirmed value, delete every tier or group the product does not need, and carry no narrative rationale, inventory, or accessibility requirement here.

com.quasar.design-system.format_target: REPLACE with the adopted DTCG specification version or draft date

validation.command: REPLACE with the project command confirmed by q-plan-tech-foundation
validation.tool_version: REPLACE with the exact pinned version

primitive.$description: Raw values named by what they are. No component or feature references a primitive directly.

0.$description: REPLACE with a confirmed ramp step

900.$description: REPLACE with a confirmed ramp step

semantic.$description: Roles that features and components consume. Themes and modes vary this tier only.

component.$description: Add an entry only when a component needs a value the semantic tier cannot express. Alias the semantic tier; never a primitive or a raw value.
